mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_DEPT a INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND d.outp_or_inp IN (0, 2)
AND d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY remainAlert DESC

SELECT doctor_name AS doctorName, dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_DOC a INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND d.outp_or_inp IN (0, 2)
AND d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY a.doctor_name, d.dept_name ORDER BY remainAlert DESC
